title: The Shy Rainbow
hook: 彩虹太害羞，一直躲着不肯出来，Dora 得帮它把颜色一块块找回来。

cells.en: A shy rainbow hides behind the yellow hill today.
cells.cn: 今天，一道害羞的彩虹躲在黄色小山后面。

cells.en: The rainbow says, “I need you to come right away.”
cells.cn: 彩虹说：“我需要你马上过来一趟。”

cells.en: The rainbow hides and says, “Azul, you're right!”
cells.cn: 彩虹躲起来说：“蓝色，你说得对！”

cells.en: The bridge has red, blue and green color boards.
cells.cn: 这座桥上的木板有红、蓝、绿三种颜色。

cells.en: Look, there are three paths in three colors.
cells.cn: 瞧，有三条颜色各不相同的小路。

cells.en: The red boat is missing some of its color.
cells.cn: 红色小船上少了一些颜色。

cells.en: Dora rows the red boat across the blue water.
cells.cn: Dora 划着红船穿过蓝色的水面。

cells.en: Dora points at the green leaf and says “¡Verde!”
The rainbow stretches wide and smiles at everyone.
cells.cn: 彩虹舒展开来，对大家笑。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Shy Rainbow”.
ending: In the end, the shy rainbow comes out and shows all its colors. My favorite part is ______.
